_about: Public-domain Alexander McKenzie (1830-1914), minister of the First Church in Cambridge, Massachusetts, for the Word Hoard: Lectures on the History of the First Church in Cambridge, The One Lawgiver (election sermon), Other Sheep I Have, Cambridge Sermons, Christ Himself, A Door Opened, The Divine Force in the Life of the World, Now, Getting One's Bearings and Some Cambridge Men I have Known. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 88 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mckenzie-first-church: Lectures on the history of the First church in Cambridge (Boston : Congregational Publishing Society, 1873)

mckenzie-other-sheep: Other sheep I have : a sermon / preached in the Shepherd Memorial Church, Cambridge, October 15, 1882 by Alexander McKenzie (Cambridge, Mass. : s.n., 1882)
mckenzie-divine-force: The divine force in the life of the world (New York, London, Lamson, Wolffe and company, 1898)
mckenzie-bearings: Getting One's Bearings, etc. [Essays.] (New York : Fleming H. Revell Co, 1903)
mckenzie-cambridge-men: Address on some Cambridge men I have known ([Cambridge, The Society, 1908)
